ayahs.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
ayahs.tr: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen

ayahs.en: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.tr: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen

ayahs.en: So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer -
Those who make show [of their deeds]
